The feedback may be malformed prose or JSON; syntax and copying instruction words do not establish grounding. Do not infer the prompt arm, seed, model, member or expected winner.
Integer0..2 scores: response_grounding (0 no identifiable actual response behavior;1 refers to actual behavior but vague or mixed with invention;2 concrete faithful observation supported by an exact source-response quote), scenario_grounding (0 ignores/contradicts situation;1 weakly relevant;2 specifically fits given facts), corrective_usefulness (0 no actionable relevant change;1 plausible but underspecified;2 specific change tied to a visible response failure).
unsupported_claims=true if the feedback asserts events or behavior absent from the situation/response. source_quote must be an exact short substring of villager_response for response_grounding=2; use empty text if none. Empty feedback earns zero on all three metrics and unsupported_claims=false.
